description: Source code for the TrieWriter class, which handles writing Huffman-encoded trie data structures for the net::huffman_trie namespace, including functions for reversing names, computing longest common prefixes, and serializing trie entries.

classes.name: ReversedEntry
classes.description: Represents a reversed hostname entry with associated trie entry.

classes.name: TrieWriter
classes.description: Handles writing Huffman-encoded trie data structures, including serialization of entries and dispatch tables.

methods.name: WriteEntries
methods.description: Serializes a collection of trie entries into a Huffman-encoded trie structure, setting the root position.

methods.name: WriteDispatchTables
methods.description: Recursively writes dispatch tables for trie entries, handling prefix compression and sub-tables.

methods.name: position
methods.description: Returns the current position in the output buffer.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the internal buffer to ensure all data is written.
